WITH monthly_gross AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ROUND((gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS increase
FROM monthly_gross
ORDER BY increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH jan_users AS (
  SELECT id, created_at
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
qualifying_users AS (
  SELECT u.id
  FROM jan_users u
  JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY u.id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) >= 2
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS total_jan_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS qualifying_users,
  ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT q.id)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT j.id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM jan_users j
LEFT JOIN qualifying_users q ON q.id = j.id

SELECT u.traffic_source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY gross_revenue_per_user DESC

SELECT ROUND(
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
    ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600
  )::numeric, 2
) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete'
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH facebook_users_2024 AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_created_at
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN facebook_users_2024 fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_id, order_created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_created_at) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_created_at END) AS first_order_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_created_at END) AS second_order_date
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
),
day_diffs AS (
    SELECT (second_order_date::date - first_order_date::date) AS days_diff
    FROM first_two
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM day_diffs

WITH users_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    created_at,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS acq_month
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
users_with_order_30d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id
  FROM users_2024 u
  JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(u.acq_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wo.id)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0) AS share
FROM users_2024 u
LEFT JOIN users_with_order_30d wo ON wo.id = u.id
GROUP BY u.acq_month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH facebook_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
    HAVING BOOL_OR(oi.status <> 'Cancelled')
),
ordered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS order_seq
    FROM user_orders
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        o1.user_id,
        o1.order_date AS second_order_date,
        o2.order_date AS third_order_date,
        (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o2.order_date - o1.order_date)) / 86400)::int AS days_diff
    FROM ordered_orders o1
    JOIN ordered_orders o2 ON o1.user_id = o2.user_id
    WHERE o1.order_seq = 2 AND o2.order_seq = 3
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff))::numeric, 0) AS median_days
FROM second_third

first_two_orders AS (

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time,
        SUM(oi.sale_price) AS order_value
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
      AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn
    FROM order_values
),
first_median AS (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn = 1
),
repeat_median AS (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT median FROM first_median) AS first_median,
    (SELECT median FROM repeat_median) AS repeat_median,
    (SELECT median FROM first_median) - (SELECT median FROM repeat_median) AS difference

WITH user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
user_ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn,
        LEAD(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS next_order_date
    FROM user_orders
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (next_order_date::date - order_date::date)) AS p95_days
FROM user_ordered
WHERE rn = 1 AND next_order_date IS NOT NULL

first_two AS (

    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn IN (1, 2)

    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2

SELECT

FROM first_two
